title: LPL 2026 Playoff Race Heats Up
byline: LPL 2026 heads into its decisive final league stage as the race for the playoffs intensifies. Galle Gallants remain on top of the standings, while Colombo Kaps, Jaffna Kings, Dambulla Sixers and Kandy Royals continue battling for the remaining top-four spots. With six league matches left at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium before the tournament moves to Colombo for the playoffs, every result could reshape the standings.

title: India recall Jadeja for Sri Lanka Tests
byline: Shubman Gill will lead India in a two-Test series against Sri Lanka, with the opening match set to begin in Galle on August 15 as part of the ICC World Test Championship 2025-27.

title: Oil prices fall 1% as investors weigh pause in US strikes on Iran
byline: Oil prices fell 1% on Tuesday as market participants continued to weigh a pause in U.S. strikes on Iran, which has raised hope of a diplomatic solution to their conflict and the normalisation of Middle East energy flows.

title: BASL President says judges’ retirement age amendment should go to referendum
byline: President of the Bar Association of Sri Lanka (BASL) Rajeev Amarasuriya yesterday expressed his personal view that the proposed Constitutional amendment seeking to increase the retirement age of superior court judges should not only secure a two-thirds majority in Parliament but should also be approved by the people at a referendum, as it has implications for the sovereignty of the people.

title: Leading Presidents’ Counsel voice serious concerns
byline: Five leading Presidents’ Counsel, including a member of the National People’s Power (NPP) Leadership Council and the Executive Council Lal Wijenayake, yesterday protested the government’s move to extend the retirement age of judges by two years.

title: Rakitha Rajapaksa, Charith Abeysinghe granted bail
byline: The Colombo Chief Magistrate’s Court today granted bail to former Justice Minister Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe’s son Rakitha Rajapakshe, former Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Horana organiser Charith Abeysinghe and former Airport and Aviation Services director Aruna Sri Chathuranga, over the bribery charges.

title: SJB MP Chaminda Wijesiri sentenced to 18 months in prison
byline: Badulla District MP Chaminda Wijesiri has been sentenced to one-and-a-half years’ imprisonment after being convicted by the Badulla High Court over a 2019 incident involving police officers.

title: Multiple deaths in human-elephant conflict
byline: A Civil defence force member and a Chena cultivator of Wijeyapura in Ethimale were trampled to death by a wild elephant on Sunday night (26) which resulted in the assault on wildlife officers.

title: China to help construct bamboo ’Bio-fence’ as solution to human-elephant conflict
byline: China has agreed to provide the necessary technical and research support to establish a ’Bio-fence’ using bamboo as a sustainable, eco-friendly solution to the long-standing human-elephant conflict in Sri Lanka.

title: Sri Lankan student selected for ShakthiSAT International Space mission
byline: Eighteen-year-old Senisa Gunawardena has been selected to represent Sri Lanka at the prestigious ShakthiSAT International Space Mission following a highly competitive selection process.

title: SriLankan links to 17 Maldives destinations
byline: SriLankan Airlines has expanded its regional network by signing a new interline agreement with Island Aviation Services, operating as Maldivian (Q2), enabling passengers to travel seamlessly to 17 domestic destinations across the Maldives under a single ticket.

title: Ganja-laced meals at roadside eateries cost consumers dearly
byline: Judicial Medical Officer (JMO) at the Peradeniya Teaching Hospital, Dr Palitha Bandara Subasinghe, raised concerns over reports that some wayside eateries are using ganja (cannabis) leaves in meat dishes to enhance flavour, a practice that is illegal and could have serious consequences for motorists.

title: Hospital capacity crisis adds to dengue death toll: Specialist warns
byline: It is regrettable that some patients who require medical treatment and special attention as inpatients are returning home without being admitted to hospitals due to the current overcrowding, which has become a contributing factor in the increase in dengue-related deaths, Specialist Dr Chamal Sanjeewa said.

title: US$2.5Mn cyber heist; COPF covers up the top brass: UNP
byline: The United National Party (UNP) yesterday charged that the Committee on Public Finance (COPF) had failed to identify the shortcomings of senior officials in connection with the cybercrime, while highlighting that the US$2.5 million heist had occurred due to the failure of the Finance Minister and the Secretary to the Finance Ministry to monitor the transition of powers from the Central Bank to the Public Debt Management Office.

title: Businessman arrested in Gampola over Rs. 2 Mn bribery scheme for hospital tender
byline: Officers from the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) have arrested a businessman and another individual in Gampola for allegedly soliciting, accepting, and aiding in a bribe of Rs. 2,000,000.

title: Uganda declares end to latest Ebola outbreak
byline: Uganda’s health minister declared the country Ebola-free on Tuesday ​following the East African nation’s latest outbreak of the viral haemorrhagic ‌disease that infected 20 people and killed two of them.

title: S&P says Sri Lanka’s Economy showing resilience, keeps rating stable
byline: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed Sri Lanka’s long- and short-term sovereign credit ratings at ‘CCC+/C’, while maintaining a stable outlook, citing continued economic recovery, strong revenue growth and improvements in fiscal management.

title: Trump flouts political risk to host Netanyahu’s seventh White House visit
byline: United States President Donald Trump is set to host Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at the White House for the seventh time during his second term, flouting the political risk of holding a high-profile meeting with the increasingly unpopular leader amid the US-Israel war with Iran.

title: Sri Lanka finish strong to beat Pakistan 2-1
byline: Chamari Athapaththu produced a captain’s performance with both bat and ball as Sri Lanka defeated Pakistan by eight wickets in the third ODI on Tuesday to clinch the three-match series 2-1.

title: Charith Abeysinghe remanded after failing to meet bail conditions
byline: Former Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) Horana organiser Charith Abeysinghe was remanded once again after failing to satisfy the bail conditions imposed by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: No plans as yet to restrict water supply despite dry conditions: NWSDB
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has said there are no plans as yet to impose water supply restrictions in any part of the country despite the prevailing El Niño-related climate conditions.

title: France evacuates 4,000 as Gironde wildfire faces renewed heat threat
byline: French authorities ordered nearly 4,000 people to evacuate tourist sites on the Atlantic coast on Tuesday as returning heat threatened firefighters’ fragile hold on a vast wildfire west of Bordeaux. The new evacuations added to a wildfire crisis across south-western Europe, where fires in France and Spain have forced about 330,000 people to leave their homes and holiday accommodation.

title: Sri Lanka to introduce rules for virtual assets, crypto firms
byline: As the government seeks to strengthen supervision of Sri Lanka’s emerging digital asset sector, the Cabinet of Ministers has approved a proposal to establish a legal framework for regulating virtual assets and virtual asset service providers (VASPs).

title: India summons top Meta executive after PM Modi’s video briefly blocked
byline: The government has summoned Meta’s public policy chief after a video posted by Prime Minister Narendra Modi was briefly removed by Facebook in India, sources said. The video in question was uploaded by PM Modi last week – at the height of the Cockroach Janta Party’s protest against leaked exam papers.

title: Sri Lankan gets 89 days in Australian prison for train assault
byline: A 22-year-old Sri Lankan man has been sentenced to 89 days in prison by an Australian court for assaulting a fellow passenger with a glass bottle aboard a train in Brisbane.

title: Cabinet approves drug law reforms to expedite disposal
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved amendments to the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance to enable the speedy disposal of confiscated narcotics and strengthen legal provisions relating to drug offences.

title: Major quake in southern Japan knocks out power, disrupts transport
byline: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Japan’s southern Kumamoto prefecture on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes, snarling travel and triggering evacuation orders and warnings for aftershocks.

title: Cabinet approves Rs. 15 Bn for phase 1 of Ruwanpura Expressway
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval to a proposal presented by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to implement the procurement process and select a suitable contractor for the first phase of the Ruwanpura Expressway Project.

title: Five unused Presidential palaces opened to private investors
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval to a proposal presented by the President to hand over several Presidential Palaces located across the country to suitable investors on a long-term lease basis.

title: Some people’s chats with Claude AI found to be publicly available online
byline: Hundreds of user conversations with Anthropic’s popular artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot Claude were found to have been available to essentially anyone online.

title: ’Warakagoda Elephant’ hit by tipper truck, injured
byline: An elephant known as the ’Warakagoda Elephant’ was injured after being hit by a tipper truck at Omaragolla, Melsiripura this morning while it was being taken to a procession.

title: International Dhamma Programme to mark Esala Full Moon Poya on July 29
byline: An International Dhamma Programme will be held on Wednesday, July 29, to mark Esala Full Moon Poya Day, bringing together participants for an online Dhamma talk via Zoom.

title: SriLankan Airlines links to 17 Maldives destinations
byline: SriLankan Airlines has expanded its regional network by signing a new interline agreement with Island Aviation Services, operating as Maldivian (Q2), enabling passengers to travel seamlessly to 17 domestic destinations across the Maldives under a single ticket.

title: NARA investigates blue bottle jellyfish presence at Panadura beach
byline: The National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) has launched an investigation into the presence of Physalia, commonly known as the blue bottle jellyfish, along the Panadura beach and issued safety advice to the public following reports of several beachgoers being stung.
